description: What is the latest version of a product right now? Returns the newest release cycle, its latest patch version and date, release date, support status and end-of-life date. Live data avoids out-of-date answers about "the latest Python/Node/PostgreSQL". Source: endoflife.date (community-maintained, typically refreshed daily); preview or beta releases are not included. (cost: 1 credit)

product.description: string, required, endoflife.date product slug (e.g. python, nodejs, postgresql)

name: eol_latest_release
